# TechFuel HQ

> Homelab, PC hardware, and self-hosting guides with first-party benchmarks
> and open datasets, written and edited by Lowell K. Wood IV in St. Louis, MO.
> Every article carries a dated evidence ledger; the editorial standard is at
> https://techfuelhq.com/methodology/

## Open datasets (CC BY 4.0 — cite the page URL)

- [RTX 5080 LLM throughput](https://techfuelhq.com/data/rtx-5080-llm-throughput/): measured ollama decode/prefill tok/s across models and context sizes on a retail RTX 5080
- [DDR5 RAM price index](https://techfuelhq.com/data/ram-price-index/): dated direct-retailer price observations for named 2x16 DDR5-6000 kits
- [HDD price index](https://techfuelhq.com/data/hdd-price-index/): dated direct-retailer $/TB observations for named NAS drives
- [GPU coil whine census](https://techfuelhq.com/data/coil-whine-database/): open community severity census, publishes distributions at n>=5 per model
- [ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5080 OC bench](https://techfuelhq.com/data/gpu/rog-astral-rtx-5080-oc-2026-06-09/): 59-row first-party bench dataset with OC offsets and provenance
- [PC part prices](https://techfuelhq.com/data/pc-part-prices-2026/): component street-price observations

## Hubs

- [Articles](https://techfuelhq.com/articles/): troubleshooting, buying guides, comparisons
- [Homelab](https://techfuelhq.com/homelab/): NAS, Proxmox, self-hosting decisions
- [Tutorials](https://techfuelhq.com/tutorials/): step-by-step self-hosting and homelab setups
- [Tools](https://techfuelhq.com/tools/): 20+ free calculators with published assumptions
- [GPU reviews](https://techfuelhq.com/gpu-reviews/): verdict-first GPU comparisons
- [Data](https://techfuelhq.com/data/): all first-party datasets
